LanguageData.APM_Mech_Vassal.label: Vassal
LanguageData.APM_Mech_Vassal.description: The mechhive’s mind isn’t a rage filled abyss towards organic life, it is cruel and calculating. It recognizes the need for coordination within its forces and that is where the vassal’s purpose lies. It gives allies around it a boost to their speed. For those who have managed to gestate their own vassal outside the hive’s grasp, it also interfaces with local comms systems, giving allies a mood boost and a decreased mental break threshold by 25%. Additionally, mechanitors can extend their command range in a radius around this mech.
